note: Dismissal and termination: the bulk of prud'homal litigation and the practice area the MVP corpus was scoped to (docs/PLAN.md §5.3). If retrieval is weak here, the product has no slice 2.

cases.query: licenciement pour motif personnel cause réelle et sérieuse
cases.note: The single most-typed employment-law query there is. L1232-1 is two sentences; the words 'cause réelle et sérieuse' also appear in L1233-2, L1235-3 and L1235-5, so lexical rank alone is nearly useless.

cases.query: convocation à l'entretien préalable au licenciement et assistance du salarié
cases.note: Procedure-of-form question where a missed article is a procedural irregularity in a real pleading. Both the convocation rule and the assistance rule are primary.

cases.query: délai minimum entre l'entretien préalable et l'envoi de la lettre de licenciement
cases.note: The answer ('deux jours ouvrables') is one clause in a long article about something else (the notification letter). Tests whether chunk-level retrieval finds a rule that is not what its article is titled after.

cases.query: barème d'indemnité en cas de licenciement sans cause réelle et sérieuse
cases.note: The 'barème Macron'. L1235-3 is mostly a numeric table, which embeds badly — a known weak spot for dense retrieval that this case is designed to surface. L1235-3-1 (the nullity carve-out) is primary because it reverses the answer.

cases.query: définition du licenciement pour motif économique suppression d'emploi difficultés économiques
cases.note: Long article, statutory vocabulary, should be easy. Its role is as a control: if a strategy misses this one, its score elsewhere is noise.

cases.query: critères d'ordre des licenciements pour motif économique
cases.note: Distinct from rup-005 by a single concept. The two together check that the reranker does not simply return the L1233 chapter for anything containing 'économique'.

cases.query: abandon de poste mise en demeure et présomption de démission
cases.note: Post-2022 rule, in force since 23/12/2022. Paired with tmp-001 and tmp-002, which run the identical query at as-of dates either side of that boundary.

cases.query: conditions de la mise à la retraite d'un salarié par l'employeur
cases.note: L1237-8 is primary because it carries the consequence a lawyer actually needs: a mise à la retraite outside the conditions is a licenciement. Retrieving the conditions without the sanction answers half the question.

cases.query: indemnité de départ volontaire à la retraite du salarié
cases.note: Near-miss pair with rup-008: départ (salarié) versus mise à la retraite (employeur), four lines apart in the same section and almost identical lexically.

cases.query: protection de la salariée enceinte contre la rupture de son contrat de travail
cases.note: L1225-4 is the protection; L1225-5 is the fifteen-day annulment window that decides whether the claim is still available. Practically, missing L1225-5 loses the case.

cases.query: que doit remettre l'employeur au salarié à la fin du contrat pour France Travail
cases.note: The query names an institution the Code does not: the article says 'organisme gestionnaire du régime d'assurance chômage'. A named-entity gap that the lexical arm cannot bridge at all.

cases.query: remboursement des allocations chômage par l'employeur en cas de licenciement nul
cases.note: L1235-4 is a bare list of cross-references with almost no substantive text — the hardest possible shape for a dense retriever, and exactly the kind of article a note de synthèse must cite.
